wish: someone should make a game that teaches the Linux command line
spec:
A simulated shell over a small fake filesystem with 13 quests that teach pwd, ls, ls -a, cat, cd, grep, mkdir, mv, rm with *, echo with > and pipes into wc.
Type real commands at the prompt; each quest clears when the command actually does the job, with a hint button, tab completion, and saved progress.
It does not run a real shell, touch your files, or cover permissions, processes or package managers.
notes: Commands: pwd ls cd cat grep wc head echo mkdir touch rm mv cp clear help, plus | pipes, > and >> redirects, * globs.
